section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.5) describes the Positivity Scale (P Scale) used to measure positive orientation in the study. Participants rated their agreement with 8 items on a 5-point scale, with scores averaged to create a composite measure. The Polish version of the scale demonstrated good psychometric properties with a Cronbach's alpha of .87.
